descripcion: Aitutaki, the most independently minded of the FWLM’s academies, has served the Principality of Regulus for generations. Known for its strong technical training, it consistently produces top-tier technicians. Due to its long-standing anti-Marik leanings, the academy remains under regular SAFE surveillance.

Kensai Kami is an intensive three-month program designed for the top MechWarrior from each regiment. Candidates face off against one another and the program’s veteran instructors, refining their skills to the highest standard. Those who complete the course are recognized as elite among the DCMS, and their families are honored with the Kensai Kami Wreath for their role in shaping such exceptional warriors

Once seen as one of the most prestigious universities in the Draconis Combine, at one time even rivaling the famous Sun Zhang MechWarrior Academy. In early 3015, irreparable damage was caused to the facility forcing its closure.  But with the onslaught of the Clan invasion, the DCMS, An Ting Legions, and the An Ting planetary government have pooled resources together to reopen the once elite institution.  Although time will tell if the school can once again rise to the level of prestige it once carried, the Combine has spared no expense to make the reopened university among the best the Combine has to offer.

The Humphreys Training Academy was originally the principal training centers for those hailing from the Duchy of Andurien. Many graduates quickly finding station in the various units hailing from the Dutchy or serving House Humphreys. Because of the Dutchy’s often tense relationship with House Marik and the rest of the League, the HTA often comes under greater scrutiny from SAFE that many other state-run institutions find themselves operating under.

This unique, year-long program—the only one of its kind in the Free Worlds League—is designed to sharpen the leadership and command abilities of its officer candidates, molding them into capable battlefield commanders.

Located on Benjamin, the Osaka Fields Proving Grounds is the largest facility of its kind in the Combine. Built around a former military base from the Succession Wars and surrounded by wild terrain, it features three live-fire ranges for BattleMech training. Proving grounds like Osaka Fields exist on every district and prefecture capital, offering those without noble lineage a rare path into the ranks of the DCMS.

The Blackjack School of Conflict was the only privately-run military academy in the Lyran Commonwealth, and was known for producing graduates with a flair for corruption, despite being excellent warriors otherwise. While its somewhat mixed reputation within the Lyran Commonwealth is well-known, it often finds itself as a popular venue for mercenaries to send staff in an effort to both train up talent and rub shoulders with those that may secure them contracts among the oligarchs of the Commonwealth.

nombre: Melissa Steiner Martial Academy of Bolan
descripcion: The MSMA was originally a training facility for local militia, but after the War College of Tamar was destroyed during the Clan Invasion it was decided to upgrade the facility in 3053 to fill in the gap left by the War College’s destruction. The school formally opened in 3055, renamed from the Bolan Military Academy in honor of the recently-assassinated Melissa Steiner.
The War College of Buena was founded in 3020 on Buena. The academy was well-funded, with excellent technical courses and respected MechWarrior and aerospace pilot training programs.

Founded on Calloway VI in the mid-2800s, the Calloway Martial College was one of three major institutions created by the Dormuth Council to address a surge in recruitment across the Free Worlds League. Established alongside the Humphreys School of Warfare on Kanata and the Athene Combat School on Atreus, CMC quickly became a cornerstone of the League’s expanded training network.

The Capella War College stands as the most prestigious military academy in the Capellan Confederation. It has produced many of the CCAF’s most influential leaders, and its graduates are highly sought after—particularly by the Capellan Hussars, who have traditionally held first choice among each year’s class.

Located on scenic Chara III, the Pacifica Training School is one of the Lyran Commonwealth’s top MechWarrior academies. In their final certification phase, cadets undergo intense solo cockpit missions in a specialized arena designed to replicate real combat conditions.

Committed exclusively to MechWarrior training, the Coventry Military Academy was a small institution which enjoyed a strong relationship with Coventry Metal Works. Who sponsor the school providing it with exclusive Metal Works products. Ensuring a cycle of dependency with its graduates that allows Coventry Metal Works to stay competitive with some of the Commonwealth's larger arms manufacturers. Such as Defiance Industries.

Every Duchy provides at least one training facility that allows for common citizens to serve in the Confederation's armed forces. While the quality of these facilities varies greatly and rarely produce graduates at the same caliber as more illustrious institutions, the low barrier to entry coupled with heavily subsidized costs for Confederation citizens gives a wide array of students from all walks of life a chance to earn a higher education and position themselves for CCAF officer training at an incredibly affordable cost. As well as providing a path to earning one’s citizenship through service to the Confederation.

One of the least prestigious academies in the Draconis Combine, DDG is essentially what its name implies: A massive Gymnasium. Cadets have the freedom to take what courses they desire and most classes are impromptu gatherings. Unlike other MechWarrior academies, the school accepts any applicant meeting the basic physical and mental standers. While only fifteen MechWarriors graduate annually, because of the DDG’s focus on battle readiness, graduates quite often prove themselves more battle ready than many who graduate more prestigious universities.

One of the oldest military academies in Lyran space, The Martial College of Donegal serves as the principle military academy for the Commonwealth’s Protectorate of Donegal. But as of 2765 its facilities were looking increasingly outdated. Despite this, the college remained a key part of the LCAF’s recruitment efforts in Donegal well into the Succession Wars.

In 2796, House Kurita systematically murdered fifty two million citizens on the world of Kentares. News of this horrific holocaust kicked off a wave of mass enlistment that the Robinson Battle Academy struggled to keep up with. To deal with the overflow, Meistmorn Academy was created through endowments from both House Sandoval and House Davion. Originally located on Hoff, the original academy was destroyed by House Kurita in the opening years of the Third Succession War. Given it’s symbolic significance, it was promptly rebuilt on Doneval II. Metallic rubble from the original campus smelted into a plaque posted at the entrance of the school containing two lone words: Remember Kentares.

Based on Benjamin, the Dover Institute emerged from the remnants of the People’s Reconstruction Effort. Known for emphasizing tactical reflection, cadets may spend days analyzing a single sim battle. Around 50 graduate annually, many moving on to command roles.

Established more recently than its peers, the Filtvelt Military Academy has long struggled with outdated gear and limited resources, earning a modest reputation within the AFFS. Its proximity to the Periphery means most of its graduates find posts with nearby commands, often serving on the fringes of the Federated Suns.

Founded on Galedon V, the Galedon Military Academy is the Combine’s oldest military school, though much of its training now takes place on the harsher world of Matsuida. Its programs focus intensely on physical endurance and survival skills—so much so that fatality rates once forced changes to the curriculum.

Every Duchy provides at least one training facility that allows for common citizens to serve in the Confederation's armed forces. While the quality of these facilities varies greatly and rarely produce graduates at the same caliber as more illustrious institutions, the low barrier to entry coupled with heavily subsidized costs for Confederation citizens gives a wide array of students from all walks of life a chance to earn a higher education and position themselves for CCAF officer training at an incredibly affordable cost. As well as providing a path to earning one’s citizenship through service to the Confederation.

Founded on Goshen by two retired generals, the War College of Goshen began as a ’Mech academy and quickly expanded into a full-spectrum military school. Known for blending live-fire training with deep academic study, WCG produces well-rounded cadets with a strong grasp of both combat and the philosophical foundations of war and governance

Following the destruction of the Radstadt Academy and the Truce of Tukayyid, the Free Rasalhague Republic’s government harbored no illusions that the hard-fought truce would only provide a momentary reprieve in hostilities with the Clans. Under the direct guidance of Överbefälhavare Christian Månsdottir and Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht, both the Frihet Training Facility, and it’s sister school, the Tyra Miraborg Memorial Academy, spared no expense in constructing one of the Inner Sphere’s most modern and rigorous training institutions specifically designed to train its cadets in anti-Clan tactics. The sky-high demand in enrollment applications has made it a challenge for non-Republican citizens to be accepted into the institute.

While the quality of these facilities varies greatly and rarely produce graduates at the same caliber as more illustrious institutions, the low barrier to entry coupled with heavily subsidized costs for Confederation citizens gives a wide array of students from all walks of life a chance to earn a higher education and position themselves for CCAF officer training at an incredibly affordable cost. As well as providing a path to earning one’s citizenship through service to the Confederation.

While the quality of these facilities varies greatly and rarely produce graduates at the same caliber as more illustrious institutions, the low barrier to entry coupled with heavily subsidized costs for Confederation citizens gives a wide array of students from all walks of life a chance to earn a higher education and position themselves for CCAF officer training at an incredibly affordable cost. As well as providing a path to earning one’s citizenship through service to the Confederation.

Throughout the Succession Wars, Irian III developed into a critical world within the Free World League’s military-industrial complex. Irian Academy of Combative Science takes full advantage of the nearby Radner Proving Grounds to train MechWarriors, including in live fire drills. Given the importance of Irian, the academy will undoubtedly continue to be one of the top training facilities within Free World League space.
More officer school than academy, Wisdom only accepts officers and candidates, with veterans often returning for refresher courses. All graduates, regardless of prior training, receive a daishō.

Founded on Kanata in late 2761 or early 2762, the Humphreys School of Warfare was created by the Dormuth Council to address surging recruitment across the Free Worlds League. It was one of three major academies established during that time, alongside the Athene Combat School and Calloway Martial College.

The school of combat instructs all of its cadets in combined-arms warfare, no matter their specialty. Often seeking out primary school graduates who accel at team-work relates sports and events. Many Sun Tzu alumni that remain in good standing with House Kurita are often offered preferred postings at finishing schools to receive additional officer training. STSC is notable in that it is the only school to award a daishō to graduates in all modes of study. Unlike many other institutions who only reward such honors to MechWarrior graduates.

Though Kilbourne Academy does produce MechWarriors, it’s more renowned for training skilled technicians. Situated on the edge of the Draconis March near the Periphery, it serves as one of the region’s few educational hubs—offering civilian classes alongside its military programs.

Kensai Kami is an intensive three-month program designed for the top MechWarrior from each regiment. Candidates face off against one another and the program’s veteran instructors, refining their skills to the highest standard. Those who complete the course are recognized as elite among the DCMS, and their families are honored with the Kensai Kami Wreath for their role in shaping such exceptional warriors

Catering to nobles who will not see actual combat, the PLO trains MechWarriors and Aerospace pilots from some of Luthien’s most distinguished families. Although the school focuses on social niceties rather than military training, though such classes are available for students who wish to pursue them. It is the rare student who avails him- or herself of all of the resources at the academy to earn a real education.

Established in 2989 on Maxwell, the Hero Training Institute gives aspiring MechWarriors—regardless of background—a shot at their dream. Though its training is considered subpar, HTI remains a rare opportunity for those who might never get one elsewhere.

Kensai Kami is an intensive three-month program designed for the top MechWarrior from each regiment. Candidates face off against one another and the program’s veteran instructors, refining their skills to the highest standard. Those who complete the course are recognized as elite among the DCMS, and their families are honored with the Kensai Kami Wreath for their role in shaping such exceptional warriors.

Tucked away on Nestor, this modest academy shapes young recruits over four intense years, preparing them to step straight into the ranks of the FWLM the moment they come of age. Despite its size, it offers a broad slate of specialties, forging disciplined soldiers ready for war the day they graduate.

Originally one of the few Star League Military Academies outside of the Terran Hegemony before the Star League collapsed, Albion Military Academy continued under the Federated Suns administration. The academy is a constant source of skilled officers for the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns, including the distinction of being the alma mater to none other than First Prince Hanse Davion.

New Avalon Institute of Science (NAIS) is home to one of the top military training facilities in the Inner Sphere. A personal project of First Prince Hanse Davion, the Federated Suns seemingly spared no expense to open the facility in 3016. Though the massive campus contains a variety of different Colleges and research facilities, within the College of Military Science cadets are trained with latest and greatest technology.

nombre: The Royal New Capetown Military Academy
descripcion: The Royal New Capetown Military Academy is a military school with a past troubled by the racism of its home planet New Capetown. Proposed reforms by the Archon aimed at curbing the school’s problematic practices have only enflamed the situation with the local populace. While none question the effectiveness of the school’s educational curriculum, a long history of abrasiveness, bigotry, and insubordination on the part of the school's graduates has cast a long shadow on the school. With many LCAF officers noting that NCMA graduate’s unwillingness to work with those they deem as their “inferiors” causing more problems than their MechWarrior talents are often worth.

Based on New Olympia in the Marik Commonwealth, the Andurien Military Institute focuses on training MechWarriors and maintains a long-standing rivalry with the nearby Lloyd Marik-Stanley Aerospace School. Notably, ten percent of its cadet slots are reserved for the children of Dispossessed MechWarriors.

Located on the former capital of New Samarkand, SZMA is the Combine’s most prestigious military academy, graduating over 400 MechWarriors annually—more than any other school in the Inner Sphere. It also trains aerospace pilots, and all graduates receive a daishō. Notable alumni include Theodore and Hohiro Kurita.

Based on New Syrtis, Warrior’s Hall is the main academy of the Capellan March. Closely tied to House Hasek, it produces loyal graduates with a strong anti-Capellan stance and benefits from direct support from the Hasek family, whose heirs often train there.

As the Duchy of Oriente’s top training facility, Princefield is known for its fierce internal competition—only the top 20% of cadets advance to MechWarrior training after 18 months of academic study. Though located outside their home province, many in House Marik have attended Princefield since Janos Marik’s graduation in 2979.

Most mercenaries lack the elite training of state-run academies, and non-state schools like Hero or Warner fall short. To fill the gap—and offer advanced courses for veterans—Wolf’s Dragoons established the Outreach Mercenary Training Command with the University of Outreach.

Originally built to train DropShip crews, the PCMS expanded after the Fourth Succession War to include training programs in almost  all areas of military training with the help of the AFFS. The school is now used as a test-bed and think tank between the military traditions of the Lyran Commonwealth, and the combined arms military doctrines of the Federated Suns. Both sides of the FedCom Alliance have shown a vested interest in ensuring that Pandora’s unconventional program finds its footing. Given the intention to eventually merge both Lyran and Federation militaries into a cohesive whole.

Located in the heart of the Pesht Military District capital, the Pesht University of Military Science is often seen as the workhorse of DCMS’ military science programs.  With a student body made up of a wide range of individuals from all walks of life within the Combine, PUMS’ diverse cadet cadre’s often bestows a sense of comradery and national pride with the wide array of ethnic cultures and customs found within the Combine.

Point Barrow Military Academy demands the best out of its cadets, favoring a practical, hands-on approach that implemented live-fire exercises as opposed to simulators. Offering courses in virtually all specializations, Point Barrow is known for producing quality technicians and engineers, but its MechWarrior graduates are also looked over favorably by the AFFS despite not carrying the prestige often associated with more elite institutions.

Considered one of the premier centers of advanced technology in the Draconis Combine, the University of Proserpina often finds itself as one of the principle universities studying the lost technology of the Star League within the Draconis Combine. Infantry crews, MechWarriors, and pilots are all trained at UP, and it’s advanced military science programs can often leverage students in the development of new 'Mechs, weapons, and recovered technologies.

Initially created as a means of training and indoctrinating the indigenous people of the recently conquered Rasalhague Military District into the Combine, the Radstadt Academy would go on to become the premier DCMS training center within the Rasalhague territories. After centuries of operation, the Academy is now seen as a beacon of higher learning within the Rasalhague community. Providing an institute in martial education that reinforces the pride and dignity of the people of Rasalhague despite its long history in service to the Draconis Combine.

Based on Robinson, the RBA serves as the main training ground for the Draconis March. Strongly backed by House Sandoval, the academy produces fiercely loyal graduates with a deep-rooted disdain for the Draconis Combine. Many Sandoval heirs train here, reinforcing its close ties to the family.

One of the few private military schools in the Federated Suns, Sakhara Academy may be small, but it turns out well-trained cadets known for their strong camaraderie. Its tight-knit culture has earned it a reputation as something of a military fraternity.

Every Duchy provides at least one training facility that allows for common citizens to serve in the Confederation's armed forces. While the quality of these facilities varies greatly and rarely produce graduates at the same caliber as more illustrious institutions, the low barrier to entry coupled with heavily subsidized costs for Confederation citizens gives a wide array of students from all walks of life a chance to earn a higher education and position themselves for CCAF officer training at an incredibly affordable cost. As well as providing a path to earning one’s citizenship through service to the Confederation.

The Sarna Martial Academy was founded as an important part of the Capellan Confederation's training program. Rivaling even the Capellan War College. The School has become an increasingly popular venue to train the many mercenaries the Confederation currently employs such as McCarron’s Armored Cavalry, and even the Northwind Highlanders.
Taken by the LCAF during the Fourth Succession War, the Sarna Martial Academy became independent after the Sarna Supremacy broke away during Operation Guerrero.

At the Sian Center for Martial Disciplines, cadets are expected to embody physical precision and ideological purity while training on the Confederation’s capital. Under the watchful eyes of elite CCAF instructors, students face intense scrutiny. The campus regularly attracts recruiters from the Warrior Houses and Death Commandos, always on the lookout for exceptional talent.

Sian University, one of the Confederation’s most prestigious institutions, runs the Hen gao Xiao-lu—or High Path—Officer Cadet Program. The program regularly accepts candidates from SCMD and other military academies throughout Capellan space.

Sanglamore Academy on Skye is another former Star League academy and is considered the twin of the famed Nagelring on Tharkad. However, the academy was severely damaged during House Kurita's attempt to invade Skye. Since then, the facility was no longer able to train naval officers. Instead, Sanglamore concentrated its efforts on the best possible MechWarrior training and education of the LCAF's warrant officers. This secures a high percentage of LIC personnel on campus. In addition, many of its graduates try to join the Skye Rangers.

Founded by a washed-up arena fighter and con artist, the Warner MechWarrior Academy is a rough imitation of the Great House academies, surviving on the dreams of Solaris hopefuls chasing fame. Since the Fourth Succession War, it’s claimed over 500 graduates, though by 3051, few remain alive, a fact Vanderholf tends to overlook.

Created during the First Succession War for the Little Kingdom of Somerset, the Military Academy of Somerset was a small institution dedicated exclusively to the training of MechWarriors and aerospace pilots. While Somerset itself might be far removed from the Commonwealth’s core worlds, the fondness of the world from a cadet branch of the Steiner royal family ensures that the academy is often well-funded and provides competitive training alternatives for those willing to be stationed away from the usual hustle and bustle of Commonwealth high society.

Every Duchy provides at least one training facility that allows for common citizens to serve in the Confederation's armed forces. While the quality of these facilities varies greatly and rarely produce graduates at the same caliber as more illustrious institutions, the low barrier to entry coupled with heavily subsidized costs for Confederation citizens gives a wide array of students from all walks of life a chance to earn a higher education and position themselves for CCAF officer training at an incredibly affordable cost. As well as providing a path to earning one’s citizenship through service to the Confederation.

nombre: St. Ives Academy of Martial Sciences
descripcion: SIAMS is the principal academy for the St. Ives Commonality. Attached to the St. Ives Institute of Science, SIAMS has its own officer training program. Following its reintegration into the Confederation, SIAMS once more began political indoctrination classes. Although the effectiveness of such courses is seen as somewhat mixed given the more independent mindsets of the St. Ives region.

The War College of Tamar was reopened in 3025, after it had been destroyed by DCMS forces during the Third Succession War, to train MechWarriors and other ground personnel. Duke Selvin Kelswa has taken it upon himself to both fund and oversee the school to ensure its graduates emerge ready to one day beat back House Kurita and restore the Tamar Pact and return its lost worlds currently under occupation.

Situated in West Point, New York on Terra, the West Point Military Academy is one of humanity’s oldest active military institutions. Originally established to train U.S. Army officers, it later became part of the SLDF’s officer training program.

The Nagelring is the Lyran Commonwealth's oldest and most prestigious military academy. Originally a Star League facility,  it was taken over by House Steiner after the Exodus of General Kerensky's SLDF. To the surprise of House Steiner, many of the former Star League instructors decided to stay on Tharkad. The Nagelring trains officers in all branches of the LCAF, including DropShip and JumpShip crews. It is known for its extensive variety of teaching aids such as Chameleon training 'Mechs and aerospace fighters.

Previously known as the Voyennaya Akademiya Tikonov, the Tikonov School of Military Discipline was reformed by Federation troops after the conquest of Tikonov. While Hanse Davion and Melissa Steiner promised that the academy would remain committed to the grassroot needs of the Tikonov system, the reality has been anything but. With dramatically scaled back budget and admissions causing angst amount the local populace. Those who once looked at the school as a symbol of planetary pride now seeing it as a sign of their oppression under the FedCom.

Once the main military academy of the Tikonov Grand Union, the VAT gradually fell behind its more modern counterparts after integration into the Capellan Confederation. Despite this, its ties to Tikonov’s key ’Mech industries keep it a point of pride for locals, with many graduates serving in regional defense forces and support roles.

Following the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar continued to utilize the battle-scarred planet as a staging ground for the Com Guard forces defending the truce line. Desiring to create an official training facility on the planet. But even after years of lobbying, the Order found funding difficult until the formation of the Second Star League in the wake of the Whitting Conference. The newly formed Star League Defense Force desired their own facility to train recruits and the Star League Council agreed to co-finance construction.

The Second Star League revived the Gunslinger Program, Hosted by Focht War College, to bolster their ability to fight against Clan opponents. Given the results of the original program, it is no surprise that those graduating from the program often end up as expert duelists.
Admission is by invitation only—except for members of the Orloff family. The academy focuses on MechWarrior training but also offers advanced instruction in leadership and combined arms tactics.

Originally founded on Terra as a family entertainment center. Their patented SimPods offered anyone a chance to experience the excitement of piloting a simulated BattleMech into combat. By the 2900’s rampant infrastructure destruction caused by the Succession Wars saw Virtual World shift its business model. Upgrading their SimPods to a military standard and offering short-term training programs on demand across the Inner Sphere. With numerous centers finding permanent residence in systems far removed from the more traditional military academies.

Every Duchy provides at least one training facility that allows for common citizens to serve in the Confederation's armed forces. While the quality of these facilities varies greatly and rarely produce graduates at the same caliber as more illustrious institutions, the low barrier to entry coupled with heavily subsidized costs for Confederation citizens gives a wide array of students from all walks of life a chance to earn a higher education and position themselves for CCAF officer training at an incredibly affordable cost. As well as providing a path to earning one’s citizenship through service to the Confederation.
